contract: A machine-local Ed25519 identity derives the stable peer ID. The optimistic peers.sqlite3 registry binds peer IDs to public keys, HTTPS origins, enabled state and separate exact send/receive category scopes. Signed proof fields are version, sender, recipient, scope, expiry and nonce; verification requires the registered public key, exact local recipient, enabled receive policy, a maximum five-minute lifetime and atomic one-time nonce consumption. The private key and nonce ledger are never projected or transported. Outbound signed JSON envelopes use the guarded network client pinned to the configured peer origin; non-loopback peers require HTTPS.
acceptance: Generate and reopen a stable 0600 Ed25519 identity; expose only peer ID and public key while retaining identity.key and peers.sqlite3 as machine-local secret/security state.
Create, revise, reload and delete cryptographically bound peers with optimistic revisions and distinct send/receive qualified category policies.

Sign and verify exact recipient/scope/expiry/nonce proofs, reject tampering, wrong recipients, disabled scopes and expired proofs, and atomically reject replay after restart-capable SQLite persistence.

Send a real signed JSON envelope through the guarded pinned-origin HTTP client and verify it at a second real PeerStore; require HTTPS outside loopback and refuse redirect widening through the shared guard.

Authenticated HTTP and native read expose the same public projection; inbound proof verification does not require a dashboard session but requires the cryptographic peer proof. Console manages actual peer records and directional policy through real HTTP.
limitations: platform.21 establishes peer identity and category authorization; domain replication, conflict handling and selective media transfer remain platform.22 and platform.24.
Local qualification proves loopback transport and cryptographic policy; it does not claim a provisioned remote peer or public certificate.
integration_hooks: Add /api/capabilities/platform/peers/proofs/verify to the shared token middleware exact bypass list; the handler itself accepts only a valid registered one-time peer proof.
Render apps/console/src/features/capabilities/platform/Peers.tsx from the shared platform Page.
Enroll capabilities/platform/identity.key and capabilities/platform/peers.sqlite3 as secret/security machine-local durability entries that are excluded from every export and replica.
The experience.world_guest scope consumes PeerStore.snapshot/allows/post_signed and verifies the proof/payload envelope with PeerStore.verify_proof.

qualification.stages: Compile and runtime passed in repair cycle 1; the UI-only second repair passed after narrowing update payloads to writable fields.
